\section{Introduction}\label{sec:intro}
Prior work \cite{alpha} and \citep{beta,gamma} motivates the method in
Section~\ref{sec:method} and the setup in Section~\ref{sec:setup}. The
alignment is shown in Eq.~\eqref{eq:aligned} and the energy relation in
\eqref{eq:energy}. Figure~\ref{fig:one} and Fig.~\ref{fig:two} show the data,
and Table~\ref{tab:one} lists the parameters; \autoref{tab:two} lists more.

\section{Method}\label{sec:method}
\subsection{Setup}\label{sec:setup}
Each record is modelled by
\begin{equation}
\begin{aligned}
  a &= b + c \\
  &\quad - d \& e
\end{aligned}
\label{eq:aligned}
\end{equation}
and the energy follows
\begin{equation}
  E = mc^2 \label{eq:energy}
\end{equation}
as usual.
